skill.name: musvideo
skill.description: Create music videos from public audio or Suno links through your MusVideo account. Review the story, approve credit charges, and track the render.
skill.summary: Turn a song into a music video with MusVideo and review costs before paid steps.
skill.author: tjsdyy

security_audit.summary: All 12 static alerts are false positives involving the documented service endpoint, an example configuration path, or Markdown formatting for MCP identifiers. The workflow separates paid approvals but does not explicitly require consent before submitting audio to MusVideo. No evidence of prompt injection or unauthorized credential transfer was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The import step lacks a separate data-sharing check.
remediation.suggestion: Before importing, confirm the exact audio source and that the user wants to send it to MusVideo. Do not import audio from planning-only requests.

semantic_findings.title: Audio Import Lacks an Explicit Sharing Check
semantic_findings.description: The skill allows implicit invocation and directs the agent to import audio before asking for project creation approval. It does not explicitly check whether the user authorized sharing the selected source with MusVideo, including host-provided attachments where supported.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions put import before the first paid approval. They require rights to the song and restrict uploads elsewhere, but do not require approval for this service transfer.

content.value_statement: Turning a song into a video requires a visual concept and clear decisions about credit costs. MusVideo lets you review the story, approve paid steps, and check the render from chat.
actual_capabilities: Import a supported public HTTPS audio link or public Suno song page without spending credits.
Create a landscape or vertical music video project after the user approves the story creation fee.
Show the generated story and submit user approval with optional feedback to generate a storyboard.
Retrieve a render quote with the total credit cost and scene count, then start the render after approval.
Check project progress, billed credits, and refunds. Request cancellation when the user asks.
Check the account credit balance, find existing projects, and retrieve a completed video or its watch link.
limitations: Requires a separate MusVideo MCP connection and browser sign-in. A read-only connection cannot create videos.
Tracks must be longer than 5 seconds, no longer than 10 minutes, and at most 50 MB. YouTube links are not supported.
Local attachments are verified only in ChatGPT. Player availability depends on the host, and render times are not guaranteed.
The integration cannot buy or add credits. Cancellation stops future work but may not prevent charges for work already running.

use_cases.title: Make a Release Video
use_cases.description: Turn your original track into a landscape video. Review the proposed story before approving rendering.

use_cases.title: Plan a Vertical Video
use_cases.description: Use a licensed track to develop a 9:16 video. Review the render quote before committing campaign credits.

use_cases.title: Follow an Existing Render
use_cases.description: Check an existing project's stage and billed credits. Retrieve the watch link when the video is complete.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Credit Balance
prompt_templates.prompt: Use MusVideo to show my current credit balance. Do not start a project.
prompt_templates.scenario: Check credits before planning a video.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Story from a Song
prompt_templates.prompt: You may import this public Suno song into MusVideo: [song link]. Plan a 16:9 video with a quiet nighttime setting. Tell me the story creation cost before starting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a new project with a specific visual direction.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Story and Render Quote
prompt_templates.prompt: Find project [project ID] and show me its current story. After I approve it and the storyboard is ready, show me the render quote. Wait for my approval before rendering.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review creative work and approve spending separately.

prompt_templates.title: Recover an Uncertain Render
prompt_templates.prompt: Check project [project ID] after a render start timed out. Report its status and billed or refunded credits without starting a duplicate. If work can resume, show a fresh quote and wait for approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Recover an existing project without repeating paid work.

output_examples.input: Show me the story before making the storyboard.
output_examples.output: The story follows a cyclist through a quiet city at sunrise. The video uses warm streetlights and slow camera movement. Approve this story or tell me what to change.

output_examples.input: What does it cost to render the approved storyboard?
output: The quote is 24 credits for six scenes. Your balance is 30 credits.
MusVideo charges as rendering progresses and reports any refunds.
The render has not started. Do you approve this quote?

output_examples.output: MusVideo reports that six of eight scenes are complete. The render is still running, and no finished video is available yet.

best_practices: Use music you have permission to use and confirm which source you want to share with MusVideo.
Specify a visual mood and aspect ratio, then review the generated story before approving it.
Keep the project ID and confirm the current quote before starting a render.
anti_patterns: Paste passwords, tokens, or browser authorization callbacks into chat.
Treat a request to create a video as approval of an undisclosed charge.
Create a replacement project after a timeout without checking the original project.

faq.question: Does installing the skill connect my MusVideo account?
faq.answer: No. Add or enable the MusVideo MCP connection in your host, then sign in and grant permissions in your browser.

faq.question: Which audio links can I use?
faq.answer: Use a public HTTPS link to an MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, or OGG file, or a public Suno song page.

faq.question: What costs credits?
faq.answer: Importing and approving the story are free. Project creation costs six credits at the documented rate, and rendering uses a separate quote. Live prices take priority.

faq.question: Do I need to keep the chat open during rendering?
faq.answer: No. Rendering continues on the server and typically takes 20 to 60 minutes. Check your existing project later for status and the finished video.

faq.question: Can I cancel an active render?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask to cancel the current render. Work already running may finish and use credits. Check reported billing for actual charges and refunds.

faq.question: Can I make videos depicting real people?
faq.answer: No. The skill declines requests to depict the likeness of real people, including celebrities and public figures.
